name: Point Leo Wine Terrace
signature: Casual vineyard-side dining at Pt. Leo Estate, overlooking the Sculpture Park. Check the current Wine Terrace service days before visiting.
editorNote: The Wine Terrace is beside Pt. Leo Estate’s cellar door, overlooking the vineyard and Sculpture Park. The operator currently lists lunch service from Friday to Sunday, with walk-in and reserved group dining options. Group reservations are seated indoors. Check the current seasonal menus and availability before planning your visit.
whyWeGo: A casual vineyard-side meal with a view over the Sculpture Park.
ifOnlyOneThing: Check Wine Terrace service days and the current walk-in or group menu before visiting.

heroImage.alt: Pt. Leo Estate, Merricks - sculpture park and lawn above Western Port, home of the Point Leo Wine Terrace
